__schema44.description: The case template to apply, clear, or leave unchanged. Requires the `xpack.cases.templates.enabled` setting. Omit to keep the current template; set to `null` to clear it; set to `{ id, version }` to switch. Switching is an explicit versioned action: both `id` and `version` are required. If `extended_fields` is also provided in the same request, those values are validated against the new template's fields. Use the get case fields API to see what fields the new template exposes.

id.description: The template identifier. Retrieve template ids with `GET /api/cases/templates`.

version.description: The template version to apply. Required on update: switching a template is an explicit versioned action, so the version must be specified.

extractObservables.description: When true, observables (for example, IPs, hashes, and URLs) are automatically extracted from case comments. When omitted on create, the space configuration default is used. Falls back to the owner's default when no space configuration exists: `true` for Security, `false` for Stack and Observability. Precedence: explicit value > template setting > space config > owner default. Observable extraction is available only for Security cases. For Stack and Observability cases, a value that is not sent resolves to `false`, even if the template or space configuration says `true`. Sending `true` returns a 400 error unless the case already stores `true`.
